description: Finds personalized illustrated children's books from the Hero of You catalogue that fit a child's age, interests and an occasion (birthday, new sibling, starting school, bedtime fears, Christmas and more). Each result has the title, a one-line summary, the published cover picture and a link to the story page. Use when a parent, relative or friend is looking for a personalized book or gift for a child aged 0 to 8. The child is drawn into the book from one photo on heroofyou.com; this tool takes no photo.

age.description: The child's age in years, e.g. 5

interests.description: What the child loves, in plain words, e.g. "dinosaurs and space" or "mermaids"

occasion.description: The occasion or moment, in plain words, e.g. "5th birthday", "new baby brother", "first day of school", "afraid of the dark", "Christmas"

name: find_story
title: Find a personalized children's story
